title: 第1046章 血昙五第1045章 血昙四
slug: 噬主成魔万魂幡饮血开锋
content_zh:
但她的小腹上多了一道剑痕——那是血色的，形状极不规则，不像一道伤口，更像一道用剑尖刻上去的印记。
那是厉惊鸿最后一道剑意留下的痕迹，他用这道剑意终止了因果逆转，也把自己的命永远刻在了她的身体里。
同悲之线断了。
柳沉烟和孟晚棠自由了。
厉惊鸿死了——这一次是真正的死，连魂魄都炸碎了，碎片融进了那道血色剑痕里，变成了一种连归墟溯源术都无法追溯的东西。
他选择在最远的距离里用最疼的方式，换她继续活着。
苏邀月跪在冰面上，双手捂着小腹上那道血色的剑痕，像在摸一个已经消失了的人的脉搏。
她低着头，长发垂下来遮住了她的脸。
没有人能看到她此刻的表情。
秦楚楚缩在角落里，手掌上那道幽绿色的纹路在因果逆转被终止后缓缓褪去了，她逃过了一劫。
但她看着苏邀月跪在地上的样子，一句话都不敢说。
整座冰山地狱安静了很长很长时间，长到封在冰柱里的那三百六十五个活人都在用凝固的眼球默默注视着这一幕。
然后苏邀月站了起来。
她的脸上还有泪痕，但她的眼泪已经干了。
她抬起手，用袖口擦掉了脸上的泪渍，动作很慢，很认真，像是在完成一个仪式。
然后她重新挂上了那张秦楚楚的脸——鹅蛋脸，远山黛，樱桃唇。
她用手指理了理散乱的鬓发，拍了拍裙摆上不存在的灰尘，转过身，对着秦楚楚笑了一下。
“秦姐姐，刚才说到哪儿了？
第七天的涅盘大典，你是不是还缺一个替你挡反噬的祭品？”
秦楚楚愣在那里。

“我刚才想了一下——我改主意了。
我本来想炸掉这里，跟你同归于尽。
但是现在有人用自己的命换了我的命。
我就不能随随便便把它用掉。
所以我决定——我来当你的祭品，替你挡下第八转涅盘的反噬。”
她朝秦楚楚走了一步，笑容灿烂得像盛开的桃花。
“你以为你吞噬我的万蛊共生体是你在吃我？
秦姐姐，你忘了——我的万蛊共生体是用蛊虫幼崽的血肉养出来的。
那些幼崽在我的骨髓里产过卵，在我的血管里打过洞，在我的眼球后面筑过巢。
它们早就把我看透了。
你想吞噬它们？
好啊。
就是不知道最后是你吞噬它们，还是它们从你肚子里面，一只一只地爬出来。”
万艳同悲窟第七层，刀山地狱。
三千六百柄利刃倒插在地面上，刀刃朝上，密密麻麻排成一座山。
每一柄刀的刀锋都薄到了极致——不是磨薄的，是用“融骨水”腐蚀出来的。
融骨水是合欢宗独门秘方，用九十九种蛊虫的胃液、未出嫁女修的第一次癸水、以及从活人膝盖骨里熬出来的骨髓油，按三七比例调配，封在千年阴木桶里埋入地底三年，开桶时那股味道能把一个筑基修士的嗅觉神经直接烧断。
用它腐蚀过的刀刃，表面会形成一层肉眼看不见的锯齿——每一个锯齿的间距，恰好是人最敏感的那层痛觉神经末梢的直径。
换句话说，每一刀割下去，不是切，是撕。
把痛觉神经一根一根地从血肉里撕出来。

秦楚楚把这座刀山叫做“美人梯”。
因为受刑的炉鼎必须赤身裸体地从刀山脚下爬到山顶，每爬一级，脚底的肉就被削掉一层。
削到腰际时，脚掌的肉已经削光了，只剩骨头。
骨头在刀刃上摩擦的声音是沙沙的，像用砂纸打磨瓷器。
等爬到山顶，脚骨会被完整地剥离下来，打磨成酒杯，用来盛放美人泪。
content_en:
But there was a sword mark on her lower abdomen - it was blood-colored and extremely irregular in shape. It didn't look like a wound, but more like a mark carved with the tip of a sword.
That was the trace left by Li Jinghong's last sword intention. He used this sword intention to end the reversal of cause and effect, and also engraved his life in her body forever.
The thread of shared sorrow is broken.
Liu Chenyan and Meng Wantang were free.
Li Jinghong died - this time it was a real death. Even his soul was shattered into pieces. The fragments melted into the bloody sword marks and turned into something that even the traceability technique couldn't trace.
He chose to use the most painful method from the farthest distance in order for her to continue to live.
Su Yaoyue knelt on the ice, covering the bloody sword mark on her lower abdomen with both hands, as if feeling the pulse of a disappeared person.
She lowered her head, and her long hair fell down to cover her face.
No one can see her expression at this moment.
Qin Chuchu huddled in the corner. The green lines on her palms slowly faded away after the reversal of cause and effect was terminated. She escaped.
But when she saw Su Yaoyue kneeling on the ground, she didn't dare to say a word.
The entire iceberg hell was quiet for a long, long time, and the three hundred and sixty-five living people sealed in the icicles were silently watching this scene with frozen eyeballs.
Then Su Yaoyue stood up.
There were still tear stains on her face, but her tears had dried.
She raised her hand and wiped away the tears on her face with her cuffs. Her movements were slow and serious, as if she was completing a ritual.
Then she put on Qin Chuchu's face again - oval face, distant mountain daisy, cherry lips.
She smoothed her messy hair with her fingers, patted the non-existent dust on her skirt, turned around, and smiled at Qin Chuchu.
"Sister Qin, where did you say just now?
In the Nirvana Ceremony on the seventh day, do you still need a sacrifice to protect you from the backlash? "
Qin Chuchu was stunned.
"I just thought about it - I changed my mind.
I originally wanted to blow up this place and die with you.
But now someone has exchanged his life for mine.
I can't just use it casually.
So I decided - I will be your sacrifice and block the backlash of the eighth nirvana for you. "
She took a step towards Qin Chuchu, her smile as bright as a blooming peach blossom.
"Do you think you are eating me when you devour my Ten Thousand Gu symbiote?
Sister Qin, you have forgotten—my Ten Thousand Gu symbiote was raised from the flesh and blood of Gu worm cubs.
Those pups have laid eggs in my bone marrow, burrowed in my veins, and built nests behind my eyeballs.
They've seen through me a long time ago.
Do you want to devour them?
OK.
I just don’t know whether you will devour them in the end, or whether they will crawl out one by one from your belly. "
The seventh floor of Wanyan Tongbei Cave, the Hell of Sword Mountain.
Thirty-six hundred sharp blades were stuck upside down on the ground, with the blades facing upwards, densely packed into a mountain.
The blade of each knife is extremely thin - not ground thin, but corroded with "bone melting water".
Bone-melting water is a unique secret recipe of the Hehuan Sect. It uses the gastric juices of ninety-nine kinds of Gu insects, the first Gui water of unmarried female monks, and the bone marrow oil boiled from the kneecaps of living people. It is mixed in a proportion of Panax notoginseng and seven. It is sealed in a thousand-year-old Yin wooden barrel and buried underground for three years. When the barrel is opened, the smell can directly burn out the olfactory nerves of a foundation-building monk.
Using its corroded blade, a layer of serrations invisible to the naked eye will be formed on the surface - the distance between each serration is exactly the diameter of the most sensitive layer of pain-sensing nerve endings in humans.
In other words, every time the knife is cut, it is not cutting, but tearing.
Tearing the pain nerves out of the flesh one by one.
Qin Chuchu called this mountain of swords the "Beauty Ladder".
Because the tortured furnace must climb naked from the foot of Daoshan to the top of the mountain, and every time it climbs, a layer of flesh is cut off from the soles of its feet.
By the time it reaches the waist, the flesh of the soles of the feet has been shaved off, leaving onlybone.
The sound of bones rubbing against the blade is rustling, like sandpaper polishing porcelain.
After climbing to the top of the mountain, the foot bones will be completely peeled off and polished into wine glasses to hold the tears of beauty.
